# Jila Betul

> Jila Betul is a civic services website for residents of Betul, Madhya Pradesh, India.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://www.betulnagar.co.in/): Civic services and ways to report local issues.
- [Betul News](https://www.betulnagar.co.in/news): Local news, alerts, events, and community updates.
- [Green Waste Services](https://www.betulnagar.co.in/department/green): Information about green waste services.

## Site information

- The site helps residents access municipal services and community information.
- Complaint, account, and staff portal pages may contain user-specific information and are not public reference content.
